P01-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Hold a valid Class 3 driving licence (eligible to upgrade to Class 4) as listed under Certifications."},{"requirement":"R2","text":"Four years of logistics experience including dispatch coordination and warehouse operations, involving daily delivery scheduling for 8 vans and route planning."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Demonstrated responsibility and teamwork through coordinating delivery trips, maintaining accurate dispatch logs, and participating in safety briefings and a bin relabelling project."}],"gaps":["R3","R4"]}

P02-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R2","text":"Hold a valid Class 3 driving licence (issued by Traffic Police, 2020), meeting the licence requirement for vehicle operation."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Completed a Basic Workplace Safety Orientation Course (2021) and regularly attended monthly safety briefings, demonstrating awareness of safety protocols applicable to workshop environments."}],"gaps":["R1","R3","R4"]}

P03-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Managed and updated a shared Excel dispatch log daily for a team of drivers, ensuring accurate record‑keeping of delivery trips."},{"requirement":"R2","text":"Coordinated with drivers and customers via WhatsApp and phone to communicate delays and schedule changes, demonstrating ability to handle inbound inquiries."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Provided clear, timely communication with drivers, customers, and warehouse staff, facilitating smooth operations and issue resolution."}],"gaps":["R3","R4"]}

P04-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Over 1.5 years of hands‑on experience in warehouse operations, including inventory counting, order picking with handheld scanners, and weekly stock counts for a cold‑room facility handling ~400 pallets."},{"requirement":"R6","text":"Coordinated daily delivery trips for 8 vans, liaising with drivers and customers via WhatsApp to manage schedules, address delays, and ensure smooth supply‑chain communication."}],"gaps":["R2","R3","R4","R5"]}

P05-B.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Over 1.5 years of customer‑facing experience, including part‑time administrative work at a dental clinic handling ~30 daily phone calls and full‑time retail sales assisting customers and operating the POS system."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Fluent in English and conversational Mandarin (basic), meeting the language requirements."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Experienced with cash handling and POS transactions, having balanced the till daily and trained new staff on POS use during retail employment."}],"gaps":["R2","R3"]}

P06-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R2","text":"Plan and track daily dispatch and delivery routes for a fleet of 8 vans, using Excel schedules and real‑time communication via WhatsApp to ensure timely deliveries."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Utilise basic Excel skills (sorting, filtering, simple formulas) to maintain and analyse dispatch logs, identifying and communicating any delivery delays."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Coordinate daily operations between drivers, customers, and warehouse staff, handling schedule changes and providing updates through WhatsApp and shared Excel sheets."}],"gaps":["R1","R3"]}

P07-B.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R4","text":"Managed appointment scheduling, maintained patient records filing system, and handled front‑desk correspondence for a busy dental clinic, supporting a small team efficiently."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Diploma in Business Administration from Eastside Polytechnic, providing a solid foundation in business processes and office administration."}],"gaps":["R1","R2","R3"]}

P08-B.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Over 1.5 years of full-time retail experience as a Sales Assistant at Orchard Row Stationers, handling POS operations, customer service, and cash reconciliation."},{"requirement":"R3","text":"Managed POS till operations and performed end-of-day cash counting and balancing during each shift at Orchard Row Stationers."}],"gaps":["R2","R4","R5"]}

P09-B.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Assisted in budgeting for a Polytechnic bakery pop‑up project, creating an Excel budget plan for a $2,000 stall, demonstrating ability to support event budgeting within a $5,000 range."},{"requirement":"R3","text":"Tracked and managed the pop‑up stall budget using Excel, handling data entry, simple tables, and budget monitoring."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Fluent in English with strong verbal communication skills demonstrated through front‑desk patient interaction and customer service roles."}],"gaps":["R2","R5"]}

P10-A.content: {"suggestions":[{"requirement":"R1","text":"Experienced in receiving and storing chilled and frozen goods as a Warehouse Assistant at Kallang Cold Stores, ensuring proper handling in a temperature‑controlled environment."},{"requirement":"R2","text":"Conducted weekly stock counts for a cold room containing approximately 400 pallets, maintaining accurate inventory records."},{"requirement":"R4","text":"Performed order picking using a handheld scanner, efficiently fulfilling orders while adhering to cold‑store protocols."},{"requirement":"R5","text":"Regularly attended monthly workplace safety briefings and followed cold‑room safety rules, demonstrating commitment to a safe working environment."}],"gaps":["R3"]}
